author: study-aperture attributed authoring review
scope: Selected published equations, not all derivations, physical realizations, or conclusions of the paper.

binding_convention.available_state_hashes: artifacts/verification.json; source-lock.json binds the source extract

outcome_policy.MET: Only the exact stated property is eligible for attributed review after evidence obligations and conflicts are examined.
outcome_policy.NOT_MET: The recorded criterion failed at its stated scope; no whole-paper falsehood or root cause is inferred.
outcome_policy.INDETERMINATE: The procedure could not establish the property; retain gaps and partial results.
outcome_policy.NOT_EVALUATED: No qualifying procedure occurred; infer neither support nor contradiction.

mappings.exact_rule: Isotropy and trace identities from equation 2 at a=7/4 after removal of nonzero common factor.
mappings.exact_conclusion: For the recorded equation 2 coefficients at a=7/4, pr=pt=rho/3 and the stress-energy trace coefficient vanishes.
mappings.quantifier_and_scope: All r>0 within the written expressions, since the shared factor 1/(a*r^2) is defined; algebraic coefficient identity only.
evidence_obligations: Inspect equation 2 and the value a=7/4
defeaters_and_limits: This does not recompute the Einstein tensor, justify the spacetime's astrophysical realization, or measure a radiation fluid.

mappings.exact_rule: Literal Eq8(k)-Eq8(j) and Eq12 agree in sign at the recorded admissible small-parameter inputs.
mappings.exact_conclusion: The two literal implemented expressions have matching signs at these three positive, small-mass, admissible inputs.
mappings.quantifier_and_scope: Only the three recorded trials; mk>mj, common E and L, positive a/r, q>mk^2, and max(m^2/q)<0.001.
evidence_obligations: Inspect equations 7, 8, 12, and the Delta-m ordering
Check square-root domain and small parameter
Execute stable rationalized difference and source expression with convergence probes
defeaters_and_limits: A failed criterion registers a candidate internal sign discrepancy, not physical falsity.
Selected PDF equations match the HTML signs; phase conventions, authorial typo, and an error in this review remain distinct possibilities.
Spinoptics terms and probabilities were not recalculated.

mappings.exact_rule: Eq12 quadrature and Eq13 endpoints differ by at most 1e-10 at three recorded inputs.
mappings.exact_conclusion: The implemented equation 12 quadrature and equation 13 endpoint expression agree within absolute tolerance 1e-10 at the three recorded trials.
mappings.quantifier_and_scope: Finite numerical tests only, away from singularities and turning points.
evidence_obligations: Execute a separately coded endpoint formula and composite Simpson quadrature
defeaters_and_limits: This is not a general symbolic proof or evidence that equation 12 follows correctly from equation 8.
Simpson step convergence is not a rigorous rounding/quadrature error certificate.

mappings.exact_rule: Restore and inspect all coordinate and unit normalizations before an SI dimension verdict.
mappings.exact_conclusion: The inspected formulation has consistent dimensions under the explicitly restored coordinate and unit conventions.
mappings.quantifier_and_scope: Only after restoring the paper's natural-unit conventions and time-coordinate rescaling.
evidence_obligations: Restore dimensions of rescaled t, r, E, L, masses, and phase
Inspect the unit convention and coordinate transformation
defeaters_and_limits: Those obligations were not completed in this pass.
Do not apply ordinary unrescaled SI-coordinate units to conclude that the metric is dimensionally wrong.

mappings.exact_rule: Inspect actual new neutrino observations compatible with the proposed signature.
mappings.exact_conclusion: The inspected physical observations support the specified model prediction within their measured conditions and uncertainty model.
mappings.quantifier_and_scope: Only a specified real dataset and matching propagation/measurement conditions, not the publication's theoretical existence.
evidence_obligations: Acquire real observation records and provenance
Establish model applicability and distinguish competing explanations
defeaters_and_limits: The paper reports no associated new data or code; this pass conducted no physical experiment.
Empirical support is NOT_EVALUATED, not contradicted because the publication is theoretical.
The mapped equation is only an entry point to the phase model, not a replacement for a complete observable model.
